description: the L of two fused boxes (flush-l-inner-fillet's operands), its convex edge along y at the top of the cap of the front box, from (1, 1, 2) to (2, 1, 2), filleted at r 0.2. The edge's end at (1, 1, 2) is the L's inner corner, a vertex of four edges, one of them the cap's smooth seam at y = 1 between the two flush pieces. A corner of a convex blend that is smooth is VertexBlend, the walk's corner edges being sharp (ADR-0043 §1, ADR-0039 §4): Arris refuses it by name, where Open CASCADE builds it (plans/flush-fan-end step 5)
